# 供给闭包：一个延续所依存的，是含它、对供给封闭的最小区域；它不用前提即推出，闭包之外的在任何一步都不向闭包所需的条件给予；清除者的网中沿依存的区域恰是各形成的供给闭包 / The feeding closure: what a continuation depends on is the least region holding it that is closed under feeding; it is reached with no premise, and nothing beyond it gives, at any step, to a condition its members require; in the clearer's web the region along dependence is exactly each formation's feeding closure

## 主张 Claim

一个形成的延续在某步被另一个供给（Flow.FedBy），是指在同一步上后者在场并向前者当时所需的条件给予。形成的区域对供给封闭（Flow.FedClosed），是指供给一个成员之延续者都是成员。g 在 f 的供给闭包之内（Flow.WithinFeeding），是指含 f、对供给封闭的每个区域都含 g。闭包含 f（Flow.WithinFeeding.refl），可传递（Flow.WithinFeeding.trans），含 f 在任何一步的每个供给者（Flow.WithinFeeding.of_fedBy），本身对供给封闭（Flow.fedClosed_within），所以是含 f、对供给封闭的最小区域。闭包之外的形成，在任何一步都不向闭包成员当时所需的条件给予（Flow.beyond_gives_nothing）。在 Clearing 中，沿依存的区域（Clearing.dependenceRegion：清除者与供给其资源的来源；来源与栖居者没有被供给，各自只含自身）对供给封闭、含其形成（Clearing.fedClosed、Clearing.dependenceRegion_closed、Clearing.dependenceRegion_self），恰是各形成的供给闭包（Clearing.dependenceRegion_iff）。栖居者在清除者的闭包之外（Clearing.dweller_beyond）；闭包之内的每步都被支持，清除者每步活跃，而栖居者从第 2 步起不被支持（Clearing.closure_supported）。不用前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 / The continuation of a formation is fed by another at a step (Flow.FedBy) when, at that step, the other takes part and gives to a condition the first then requires. A region of formations is closed under feeding (Flow.FedClosed) when whatever feeds a member's continuation is a member. g lies within f's feeding closure (Flow.WithinFeeding) when every region closed under feeding that holds f holds g. The closure holds f (Flow.WithinFeeding.refl), is transitive (Flow.WithinFeeding.trans), holds every feeder of f at any step (Flow.WithinFeeding.of_fedBy) and is itself closed under feeding (Flow.fedClosed_within), so it is the least region closed under feeding that holds f. A formation beyond the closure gives nothing, at any step, to a condition a member then requires (Flow.beyond_gives_nothing). In Clearing the region along dependence (Clearing.dependenceRegion: the clearer with the source that feeds its resource; the source and the dweller, which nothing feeds, each alone) is closed under feeding and holds its formation (Clearing.fedClosed, Clearing.dependenceRegion_closed, Clearing.dependenceRegion_self), and is exactly each formation's feeding closure (Clearing.dependenceRegion_iff). The dweller lies beyond the clearer's closure (Clearing.dweller_beyond); everything within that closure is supported at every step and the clearer is active at every step, while the dweller is unsupported from step 2 on (Clearing.closure_supported). No premise and no Lean axiom is used.

Canonical source: [Interdependence.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Interdependence.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 供给读作同一步上向所需条件的给予（Flow.FedBy）；经条件的延迟输送不算供给。 / Feeding is read as giving, at a common step, to a condition required (Flow.FedBy); delayed conveyance through conditions does not count.
- 闭包是形成层面的：在任何一步供给即在闭包之内，链上各环可以在不同的步，也不按时间先后。 / The closure is at the level of formations: feeding at any step puts a formation within it, and the links of a chain may lie at different steps, in any temporal order.
- Clearing 的结论：见证的流、网与依存（Clearing.flow、Clearing.web、Clearing.dependent）。 / For the Clearing results: the witness's flow, web and dependence (Clearing.flow, Clearing.web, Clearing.dependent).
- 离散的步（从第 0 步计）；自然数的水平、所需与数量。 / Discrete steps, counted from step 0; natural-number levels, needs and amounts.

路线 (b) 是 AI 的表述，Ren 引用了它：“No axiom. The theory only describes, and “should” is what a center does once its represented boundary matches what it actually depends on. The theory then explains recognition and motivation but claims no warrant beyond them.” Ren 选定：“let's aim for a first, then try to archive b”。作者的读法（AI 论证，待 Ren）：供给闭包读“what it actually depends on”。P40 也把它读作 Ren 的“the system that one is in”，作为从一个中心沿依存到达的系统；这一读法由 P42 撤回：供给闭包在影响闭包之内，影响闭包与所及闭包都在系统之内，为那一层级提供的是所及闭包（见 levels-of-closure，AI 的读法，待 Ren）。名称（FedClosed、WithinFeeding、Overshoot 等）是 AI 按 Ren 的命名准则所选。 / Route (b) is the AI's wording, which Ren quoted: “No axiom. The theory only describes, and “should” is what a center does once its represented boundary matches what it actually depends on. The theory then explains recognition and motivation but claims no warrant beyond them.” Ren chose: “let's aim for a first, then try to archive b”. The author's reading (an AI argument, pending Ren): the feeding closure reads “what it actually depends on”. P40 also read it as Ren's “the system that one is in”, the system reached from a center along dependence; P42 withdraws that reading: the feeding closure lies within the influence closure, the influence and reach closures lie within the system, and the reach closure is offered for that level (see levels-of-closure; the AI's reading, pending Ren). The names (FedClosed, WithinFeeding, Overshoot and others) are the AI's, chosen by Ren's naming standard.

Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器成功实查（20261011T073932.785239Z）：Becoming.Interdependence 的 30 项定理全部空依赖；同一回执覆盖包内 42 个模块（含只作导入的根模块与桥接），共 2306 项定理／3450 项声明审计，15 个继承模块的当前字节与已通过回执一致；外围回执 20261011T074322.969802Z 通过。检查器另核对核心纯净：核心（GenerativeCore、InquirySufficiency、RelationalRenewal、L1–L4 与根模块 Becoming）的导入闭包恰为这 44 个模块，其中每条源声明的公理报告为空（Lean 生成的常量中，只有带字段构造子的单射引理 injEq 依赖 propext，没有源声明使用它们，检查器逐一列出），并且只用 Lean 内置前导即可编译（基础模块的 import Std 在该次编译中去掉）。作者反审见整合文档 §56；尚未经独立审查。 / Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261011T073932.785239Z): the 30 theorems of Becoming.Interdependence all have empty axiom reports; the same receipt covers the package's 42 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 2306 theorems/3450 declaration audits, and 15 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261011T074322.969802Z passed. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 44 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §56 of the integration note; not yet independently reviewed.

供给只计同一步的给予，经条件的延迟输送不计入，所以闭包可能漏掉这样的依存；闭包是形成层面的，计入任何一步的供给者，不按时间先后，所以含已停止供给者，不是当下的依存；不模型中心怎样形成或表示其闭包；不含伦理谓词，不说中心应当做什么；读法（“what it actually depends on”；把它也读作“the system that one is in”已由 P42 撤回）与名称是 AI 的，待 Ren；供给闭包在影响闭包之内，经他者传递的影响不在其中（见 levels-of-closure）。 / Feeding counts giving at a common step only, and delayed conveyance through conditions is not counted, so the closure may miss such dependence; the closure is at the level of formations, counting feeders at any step and in any temporal order, so it holds formations that have stopped feeding and is not present dependence; nothing models how a center forms or represents its closure; contains no ethical predicate and says nothing of what a center should do; the readings (“what it actually depends on”; reading it also as “the system that one is in” is withdrawn by P42) and the names are the AI's, pending Ren; the feeding closure lies within the influence closure, and influence passing through others is not in it (see levels-of-closure).

- 供给闭包不是沿每个已形成关系的范围：Clearing 中栖居者与清除者经栖息地相关（Clearing.center_not_derived），却在清除者的供给闭包之外（Clearing.dweller_beyond）。 / The feeding closure is not the extent along every formed relation: in Clearing the dweller is related to the clearer through the habitat (Clearing.center_not_derived), yet lies beyond the clearer's feeding closure (Clearing.dweller_beyond). ## 复用与下一增量 Reuse and next delta

经条件的延迟输送是否算供给；按步、按时间先后的依存范围；中心怎样形成并表示其闭包的模型；Ren 的判断：供给闭包是否读出“what it actually depends on”（“the system that one is in”的读法已由 P42 撤回，所及闭包是否读出它见 levels-of-closure）。 / Whether delayed conveyance through conditions counts as feeding; dependence step by step and in temporal order; a model of how a center forms and represents its closure; Ren's judgment whether the feeding closure reads “what it actually depends on” (the reading as “the system that one is in” is withdrawn by P42; whether the reach closure reads it is in levels-of-closure).
